AI · Civic Tech · Live Product

CiviAI

CiviAI is an AI government copilot that helps citizens understand government activity (news, budgets, projects and policy) in plain language. Users get a daily briefing, can ask the AI assistant anything about government, track promises and public spending, and follow investigations in a dedicated newsroom.

  • Conversational AI assistant for government & civic questions
  • Daily briefings tracking news, budgets and policy in one place
  • Promise tracking, project monitoring and a verified newsroom feed
Python FastAPI AI / LLM Cloud Hosting

AI · Campus Tech · Live Product

Civi Campus

Civi Campus is a mobile-first campus intelligence platform that connects students with their institution through AI-powered information, reporting, insights, services and communication. It turns scattered campus information into a simpler, more accessible experience, while giving institutions structured insight into emerging issues and student needs.

  • AI copilot for campus questions: SUG promises, officers, general info
  • Anonymous campus issue reporting with category & photo support
  • SUG promise tracking, governance dashboard and campus newsroom
HTML CSS Python FastAPI PostgreSQL JWT Auth
Live Demo
AI · EdTech · Live Product

IMOWE

IMOWE, "a smarter way to learn," is an AI-powered academic platform that connects study materials, lectures, AI tutoring, assessments, learning memory and academic intelligence into one personalized learning ecosystem. It helps students understand what they're learning, measure their progress, identify weaknesses and determine what to study next.

  • Conversational AI tutor that explains, quizzes and summarizes on demand
  • Study Space for organizing courses and tracking completion
  • Analytics dashboard surfacing strengths, scores and study time
